description: Base token verdict from a real trade: we execute a buy and a full sell of the token in one simulated Base block and grade it BASED, MID, COOKED or RADIOACTIVE (honeypot), with a one-liner, the round-trip cost, the pool and owner status. $0.01 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: base_token_verdict
